proof.text: Obtain b and its two coordinate formulas from the coordinate-construction theorem. The sheafification adjunction makes precomposition with tau injective on sheaf morphisms; projection extensionality and pure-tensor extensionality reduce all three laws to the two coordinate formulas.

Naturality: represent each of the two stalk elements on one neighbourhood. The germ formula and naturality of tau show t(f_x(a),g_x(c))=(f tensor g)_x(t(a,c)). The induced Godement map applies f_x and g_x to the evaluated coordinates, giving the desired equality after every projection and on every pure section tensor.

Unit: the projection of the germ unit sends a section to its germ. The b coordinate formula followed by the t germ formula gives exactly the germ of its sectionwise tensor, which is the corresponding projection of the tensor-coefficient unit.

Multiplication: its x coordinate evaluates the outer coordinate and then the inner coordinate. Represent two stalk elements of T(H),T(K) on a common neighbourhood. The two coordinate formulas prove eval_(H tensor K)(b_x(t_(T(H),T(K))(a,c)))=t_(H,K)(eval_H(a),eval_K(c)). After each product projection, precompose with tau on T(T(H)),T(T(K)) and test pure tensors. The left side tensors the two twice-evaluated coordinates; the right side first applies b to outer coordinates, then T(b), then multiplication, and the displayed evaluation identity makes the outputs identical.

theorem moduleCup_godement_beta_maps_exists (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ b : ∀ H K : X.Modules,
        moduleCup_godementObject X H ⊗ moduleCup_godementObject X K ⟶
          moduleCup_godementObject X (H ⊗ K),
      (∀ (H K H' K' : X.Modules) (f : H ⟶ H') (g : K ⟶ K'),
        (moduleCup_godementMap X f ⊗ₘ moduleCup_godementMap X g) ≫ b H' K' =
          b H K ≫ moduleCup_godementMap X (f ⊗ₘ g)) ∧
      (∀ H K : X.Modules,
        (moduleCup_godementUnit X H ⊗ₘ moduleCup_godementUnit X K) ≫ b H K =
          moduleCup_godementUnit X (H ⊗ K)) ∧
      (∀ H K : X.Modules,
        (moduleCup_godementMultiply X H ⊗ₘ moduleCup_godementMultiply X K) ≫ b H K =
          b (moduleCup_godementObject X H) (moduleCup_godementObject X K) ≫
            moduleCup_godementMap X (b H K) ≫ moduleCup_godementMultiply X (H ⊗ K))

title: Coordinatewise Godement tensor pairing
statement: For every scheme X, there exist maps b(H,K): T(H) tensor T(K) → T(H tensor K), where T and its action and unit are those of [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model] and multiplication is that of [def-sc-module-cup-godement-codegeneracies]. The maps are natural in H and K, satisfy (eta_H tensor eta_K); b(H,K) = eta_(H tensor K), and (mu_H tensor mu_K); b(H,K) = b(TH,TK); T(b(H,K)); mu_(H tensor K). Composition is left to right. This asserts only the one-step pairing, not any iterate pairings.
